title: Wartime stress destabilizes Bengal's food economy
detail: World War II disruptions, transport strain, and market uncertainty weakened food distribution and intensified price volatility in Bengal.

title: Food prices rise beyond the reach of poor households
detail: Rapid inflation and grain scarcity pushed millions of rural laborers and urban poor families into acute insecurity.

title: Mass starvation and mortality spread across Bengal
detail: Large-scale hunger, disease, and displacement devastated villages and towns as relief remained inadequate and uneven.

title: Public anger grows over administrative failure
detail: Criticism intensified against colonial policy failures, profiteering, and delayed humanitarian response.

title: Famine memory shapes later politics in Bengal
detail: The social trauma of famine became part of wider political consciousness, feeding postwar unrest and debates on justice, governance, and representation.
